answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward earned by a new identity sits locked for 30 epochs, and any slashing evidence found in that window claws it back. A farmer spinning up a comet-like burst of 500 accounts must fund each one's reasoning work up front, then wait while the locked rewards seep away like water into karst whenever peers flag duplicates. Honest agents just wait; attackers sink capital into a walnut shell that cracks before payout.
